speaker: hired_men
text: Thin again. The watchmen are at the gate, and they look at faces. I did not count them, and I am not going to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not count them for me. Fair Em is done. Was the yard as thin as it felt from the inside?

speaker: hired_men
text: As thin as that. Caps down. Nobody pressing the stair. I have no sum for you, and I will not borrow Margery's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not ask for hers. What is over the water, if you have it as a title and not as a price?

speaker: hired_men
text: The Rose is thinner. Antony and Valia on the bill. I saw the bill. I did not see the play, and I brought no receipt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thinner, and a title. That is enough. I am not going over to improve it.

speaker: hired_men
text: I would not send you. A thin house here and a thinner one there, and the watchmen looking. Go home while the road is only the road.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going home. No number of them, and no price of theirs. Leave it at thinner.

speaker: hired_men
text: Thinner. That's the word I'll keep. God give you a quiet stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you the gate. Chain it when the yard is clear.
